---
name: Feature / Content Request
about: Suggest a new coloring page, feature, or improvement
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

**What would you like to see?**
A clear description of the feature or content you're requesting.

**Is this a new coloring page?**
If yes: which historical figure, era, or event? (e.g. "Harriet Beecher Stowe", "Battle of Thermopylae")

**Is this a UI or feature improvement?**
Describe the problem it solves and who benefits (students / teachers / parents).

**Any examples or references?**
Links, screenshots, or descriptions of similar things done well elsewhere.

**Additional context**
Anything else that would help prioritize or implement this.
